# pve_node_tasks (Data Source)

Reads the finished task list of one node (`GET /nodes/{node}/tasks`). Rows are PVE's archive of completed worker tasks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_node_tasks" "pve1" {
  node       = "pve1"
  limit      = 50
  typefilter = "vzdump"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name whose tasks to list.

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Only list this number of tasks. Defaults to `50` upstream; `0` disables the cap.
- `since` (Number) Only list tasks since this UNIX epoch timestamp.
- `statusfilter` (String) Comma-separated list of task states that should be returned (e.g. `OK,ERROR,running`).
- `typefilter` (String) Only list tasks of this type (e.g. `vzstart`, `vzdump`).
- `until` (Number) Only list tasks until this UNIX epoch timestamp.
- `userfilter` (String) Only list tasks from this user (e.g. `root@pam`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `node` form (same as the `node` attribute).
- `tasks` (Attributes List) Finished tasks, most recent first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Read-Only:

- `endtime` (Number) Task end time as UNIX epoch seconds; null for unfinished rows.
- `id` (String) The task's object ID (e.g. the VMID); null for tasks without one.
- `node` (String) The node the task ran on.
- `pid` (Number) The worker process ID; null when PVE did not report it.
- `pstart` (Number) The worker start position in the process table; null when PVE did not report it.
- `starttime` (Number) Task start time as UNIX epoch seconds.
- `status` (String) The task's end status (e.g. `OK`, `ERROR: ...`); null for tasks that never recorded one.
- `type` (String) The worker type (e.g. `vzdump`, `aptupdate`).
- `upid` (String) The task's unique ID.
- `user` (String) The user who started the task.
